name: story-highlights
title: Highlights story
description: Dot animation of a search result whose most relevant passage is highlighted.
usage: Result highlights on a search product card (second of the Search page capabilities). Plays only on screen; shows its resting picture with reduced motion.
avoid: Stories as the main content of a page
notes: A result card builds from the top with its source, title and a high relevance chip, then a marker runs down beside the middle of the passage and its three lines fill in, one after another.

reference.scope: Tokenized, framework-independent adaptation. Public measurements cover shared styles; retained variants are not a claim of current public-page parity.
